71407-nature-s-carol-singers.title: Nature S Carol Singers
71407-nature-s-carol-singers.creator: Unknown
71407-nature-s-carol-singers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The study of our native song birds will be found to contain many delightful curiosities, and to present not a few entertaining problems. For instance, all our first-class melodists, such as the Nightingale, Song Thrush, Blackcap Warbler, Woodlark, and Garden Warbler, are dressed in the most sober of sober colours.

arxiv-1805-08425.title: An Integrated First-Order Theory of Points and Intervals over Linear Orders (Part I) Thanks: We would like to thank Dr. Davide Bresolin, of the University of Padova, for his help. The research of the first author was supported by the National Research Foundation of South Africa grant number 81309..
arxiv-1805-08425.creator: Willem Conradie, Salih Durhan, Guido Sciavicco
arxiv-1805-08425.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Willem Conradie, Salih Durhan, Guido Sciavicco. There are two natural and well-studied approaches to temporal ontology and reasoning: point-based and interval-based. Usually, interval-based temporal reasoning deals with points as a particular case of duration-less intervals. A recent result by Balbiani, Goranko, and Sciavicco presented an explicit two-sorted point-interval temporal framework in which time instants (points) and time periods (intervals) are considered on a par, allowing the perspective to shift between these within the formal discourse.

arxiv-1806-01906.title: Achieving Data Dissemination with Security using FIWARE and Intel Software Guard Extensions (SGX)
arxiv-1806-01906.creator: Dalton Cézane Gomes Valadares, Matteus Sthefano Leite da Silva, Andrey Elísio Monteiro Brito, Ewerton Monteiro Salvador
arxiv-1806-01906.description: Abstract The Internet of Things (IoT) field has gained much attention from industry and academia, being the main subject for numerous research and development projects. Frequently, the dense amount of generated data from IoT applications is sent to a cloud service, that is responsible for processing and storage.

arxiv-1811-02536.title: A Bisimilarity Congruence for the Applied π \pi -Calculus Sufficiently Coarse to Verify Privacy Properties
arxiv-1811-02536.creator: Ross Horne
arxiv-1811-02536.description: Abstract . This paper is the first thorough investigation into the coarsest notion of bisimilarity for the applied π \pi -calculus that is a congruence relation: open barbed bisimilarity . An open variant of labelled bisimilarity ( quasi-open bisimilarity ), better suited to constructing bisimulations, is proven to coincide with open barbed bisimilarity.

The second author was partially supported by Fondecyt Grants 11180024, 1190991. The third author was partially supported by Fondecyt Grant 1180073.
arxiv-2004-14811.creator: Milagros Izquierdo, Sebastián Reyes-Carocca, Anita M. Rojas
arxiv-2004-14811.description: Abstract . In this article we determine the maximal possible order of the automorphism group of the form a ​ g + b ag+b , where a a and b b are integers, of a complex three and four-dimensional family of compact Riemann surfaces of genus g g , appearing for all genus.

arxiv-2101-06791.title: The Euler Class from a General Connection, Relative to a Metric
arxiv-2101-06791.creator: Brian Klatt
arxiv-2101-06791.description: Abstract . We extend the well-known formula for the Euler class of a real oriented even-dimensional vector bundle in terms of the curvature of a metric connection to the case of a general linear connection provided a metric is present. We rewrite the classical Gauss-Bonnet theorem in dimension two in light of this formula.

arxiv-2112-04036.title: DeepDiagnosis: Automatically Diagnosing Faults and Recommending Actionable Fixes in Deep Learning Programs Conference: The 44th International Conference on Software Engineering; May 21–29, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks CCS: Softw
arxiv-2112-04036.creator: Mohammad Wardat, Breno Dantas Cruz, Wei Le, Hridesh Rajan
arxiv-2112-04036.description: Abstract . Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are used in a wide variety of applications. However, as in any software application, DNN-based apps are afflicted with bugs. Previous work observed that DNN bug fix patterns are different from traditional bug fix patterns.

arxiv-2203-10151.title: Orbital physics: glorious past, bright future
arxiv-2203-10151.creator: D. I. Khomskii
arxiv-2203-10151.description: Abstract Transition metal (TM) compounds present a very big class of materials with quite diverse properties. There are among them insulators, metals, systems with insulator–metal transitions; most magnetic systems are TM compounds; there are among them also (high- T c T_{c} ) superconductors.

arxiv-2208-02920.title: Deductive Verification of Smart Contracts with Dafny Thanks: Extended version of the FMICS’22 conference paper.
arxiv-2208-02920.creator: Franck Cassez (✉), Joanne Fuller, Horacio Mijail Antón Quiles
arxiv-2208-02920.description: Abstract We present a methodology to develop verified smart contracts. We write smart contracts, their specifications and implementations in the verification-friendly language Dafny . In our methodology the ability to write specifications, implementations and to reason about correctness is a primary concern. We propose a simple, concise yet powerful solution to reasoning about contracts that have external calls .

arxiv-2311-15585.title: Dawning of a New Era in Gravitational Wave Data Analysis: Unveiling Cosmic Mysteries via Artificial Intelligence — A Systematic Review
arxiv-2311-15585.creator: Tianyu Zhao, Ruijun Shi, Yue Zhou, Zhoujian Cao, Zhixiang Ren
arxiv-2311-15585.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tianyu Zhao, Ruijun Shi, Yue Zhou, Zhoujian Cao, Zhixiang Ren. Gravitational wave data analysis (GWDA) faces significant challenges due to high-dimensional parameter spaces and non-Gaussian, non-stationary artifacts in the interferometer background, which traditional methods have made significant progress in addressing but continue to face limitations. Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) algorithms, offers potential advantages, including computational efficiency, scalability, and adaptability, which may complement traditional approaches in tackling these challenges more effectively.

arxiv-2410-09623.title: Quebec Automobile Insurance Question-Answering With Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2410-09623.creator: David Beauchemin, Richard KhouryUniversité Laval, Québec, Canada, Computer Science Department
arxiv-2410-09623.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) perform outstandingly in various downstream tasks, and the use of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture has been shown to improve performance for legal question answering Nuruzzaman and Hussain (2020) ; Louis et al. (2024) . However, there are limited applications in insurance questions-answering, a specific type of legal document.

arxiv-2502-19745.title: Static task mapping for heterogeneous systems based on series-parallel decompositions
arxiv-2502-19745.creator: 1 st Martin Wilhelm, 2 nd Thilo Pionteck
arxiv-2502-19745.description: Abstract Modern heterogeneous systems consist of many different processing units, such as CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs and AI units. A central problem in the design of applications in this environment is to find a beneficial mapping of tasks to processing units.

arxiv-2504-01768.title: Updating the Ephemeris and Physical Properties of Five Long-period Transiting Exoplanets Using TESS and CHEOPS
arxiv-2504-01768.creator: Suman Saha
arxiv-2504-01768.description: Abstract The transiting long-period exoplanets are the most interesting follow-up targets for the next-generation instruments, using the most sophisticated observational techniques. However, the scarcity in their transit events often leads to larger uncertainties in their known ephemeris, also resulting in larger biases in their known physical properties in many cases.

arxiv-2507-18242.title: Boosting Revisited: Benchmarking and Advancing LP-Based Ensemble Methods
arxiv-2507-18242.creator: Fabian Akkerman f.r.akkerman@utwente.nl, Julien Ferry julien.ferry@polymtl.ca, Christian Artigues christian.artigues@laas.fr, Emmanuel Hébrard hebrard@laas.fr, Thibaut Vidal thibaut.vidal@polymtl.ca
arxiv-2507-18242.description: Abstract Despite their theoretical appeal, totally corrective boosting methods based on linear programming have received limited empirical attention. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale experimental study of six LP-based boosting formulations, including two novel methods, NM-Boost and QRLP-Boost, across 20 diverse datasets.

arxiv-2601-03333.title: Optimal Quantization of Finite Uniform Data on the Sphere
arxiv-2601-03333.creator: Mrinal Kanti Roychowdhury
arxiv-2601-03333.description: Abstract . This paper develops a systematic and geometric theory of optimal quantization on the unit sphere 𝕊 2 \mathbb{S}^{2} , focusing on finite uniform probability distributions supported on the spherical surface—rather than on lower-dimensional geodesic subsets such as circles or arcs.

pmc-12976854.description: Abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) is a lethal vascular disease, in which apoptosis and inflammation participate. However, the regulatory factors associated with aortic status remain unclear; therefore, a deeper understanding of the cell types and signaling pathways involved in the pathological process of AAAs is key to the development of medical treatments.

pmc-13203803.title: Impact of PA-100 AST System Rapid Antibiotic Susceptibility Test on Antibiotic Prescription for Community-Acquired Urinary Tract Infections in Spanish Primary Care Settings
pmc-13203803.creator: Lourdes Martínez-Berganza Asensio, Gonzalo Largo-Rojo, Ana Isabel Menéndez-Fernández, Carmen Solano-Villarrubia, María Fuentes-Romero, José Medina-Polo
pmc-13203803.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: This intervention study compared the impact of the PA-100 AST System (PA-100) with the standard of care on antibiotic-prescribing behaviour for community-acquired urinary tract infections in a Spanish primary care setting. Methods: Women seeking care for symptoms of uncomplicated urinary tract infections were recruited based on the last digit of their regional personal identification number in a control (no PA-100 result available) or intervention (PA-100 result available) arm.

pmc-13664905.title: Red Blood Cells Beyond Oxygen Transport: Dynamic Regulators, Disease Biomarkers and Therapeutic Platforms—A Narrative Review
pmc-13664905.creator: Joan-Lluis Vives-Corrons
pmc-13664905.description: Red blood cells (RBCs) have traditionally been regarded as passive carriers of respiratory gases. Increasing evidence, however, indicates that they are active participants in vascular homeostasis and respond to mechanical, metabolic, and oxidative stimuli. This narrative review examines the interconnected roles of RBCs as regulators of vascular physiology, indicators of hereditary and systemic disease, therapeutic targets, and delivery platforms.
